EXPLORE AN ASSUMPTION

What if monthly price pressure changes?

Adjust contributions to headline m/m inflation, in percentage points. These are your assumptions around the rebased July-origin path, not estimated pass-through or model predictions.

Rebased archived pathYour scenario

The price-level ratios are compounded exactly and each shock leaves the y/y calculation after 12 months. The display ends at the archived model horizon. For example, +0.05 means +0.05 pp of headline m/m each affected month, not a 0.05% commodity-price move.

EXPLAIN THE DIFFERENCE

Where does the gap to the CNB come from?

Diagnostic accounting in the older R27 replay lane. Components use fixed weights and some h0 splits use realised data. The residual absorbs reconciliation and coverage differences; it is not an identified economic cause. These are not the current R31B path's component gaps.

Component paths and the gap to the CNB

Block charts are diagnostic: some h0 component splits use realised h0 because forecast splits were not archived. They are not ex-ante component forecasts. Core/food/fuel/administered model blocks differ from the overview's eight analytical blocks.

Frozen replay roster dated 20 September 2026, using the earlier R27 input lane. Reconstructed forecasts; no untouched holdout or prospective record. Realised outcomes are the available current vintage. A quarter is scored only when all three outcomes exist.

READING THE EVIDENCE

Keep these distinctions visible

  • Flash ≠ full detail. Each panel carries its own month.
  • Contribution ≠ acceleration. The driver selector answers either question.
  • Correlation ≠ pass-through. Pipeline relationships are descriptive and sample-dependent.
  • Rebased ≠ re-estimated. Substituting actual prints does not update future monthly forecasts.
  • Model spread ≠ uncertainty band. No probability interpretation is assigned to the model range.
  • Historical replay ≠ prospective record. Forecasts are reconstructed at historical information clocks.
